"""Compact matched/parent quality changes and fixed context displacements."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1')
scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');groups=[]
for end in ['raw','EMA']:
    method=f'harmonic-context-{end}-step1000';control=f'paired-control-{end}-step1000'
    for a in scores['summary']:
        if a['method']!=method or a['kind']=='real':continue
        key=a['kind'],a['condition'],a['cohort']
        candidates=[b for b in scores['summary'] if (b['kind'],b['condition'],b['cohort'])==key]
        for base in ['parent',control]:
            b=next(b for b in candidates if b['method']==base)
            fields={k:{'candidate':v,'baseline':b[k],'percent_change':100*(v/b[k]-1) if b[k] else None}
                for k,v in a.items() if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and k not in ['cases','condition'] and k in b}
            groups.append({'method':method,'baseline':base,'kind':key[0],'condition':key[1],'cohort':key[2],'fields':fields})
removal=read(root/'context-removal-result-v1.json');effects=[]
for end in ['raw','EMA']:
    for kind in ['mesh','flat','mixed-quiet','real','photo']:
        r=[r for r in removal['records'] if r['endpoint']==f'harmonic-context-{end}-step1000' and r['kind']==kind]
        effects.append({'endpoint':end,'kind':kind,'cases':len(r),
            'minimum_RMS_DN16':min(x['effect_RMS_DN16'] for x in r),'maximum_RMS_DN16':max(x['effect_RMS_DN16'] for x in r),
            'maximum_abs_DN16':max(x['effect_maximum_abs_DN16'] for x in r)})
output=root/'matched-effects-summary-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-array-only-matched-summary','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'context_removal':ref(root/'context-removal-result-v1.json'),'comparisons':groups,'context_effect_ranges':effects,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'All fixed raw/EMA endpoints and all existing scored cohorts. Matched comparison changes context/capacity at same data/loss;parent/retained differences include other changes. Context removal reports displacement only,not improved accuracy or isolated training causality.'})
for g in groups:
    if g['baseline']=='parent':continue
    fields=['template_gain','blank_error_RMS_DN16'] if g['kind']=='mesh' else ['quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16'] if g['kind']=='mixed-quiet' else ['full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16']
    print(g['method'],g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],{k:g['fields'][k] for k in fields if k in g['fields']})
for e in effects:print('CONTEXT',e)
